explication:
## Purpose and entry points
OpenCompass is a Python evaluation framework for foundation/LLM models. It composes model, dataset, prompting, inference, evaluation, and reporting configurations into reproducible runs. Primary entry points are the CLI implementation at `opencompass/cli/main.py`, repository launcher `run.py`, and executable Python experiment definitions under `examples/`, e.g. `examples/eval_chat_demo.py`.

## Configuration-driven experiment assembly
Experiments select predefined or custom models, datasets, and summarizers from a large Python-config catalog. Dataset variants encode generation, perplexity, raw-prompt, LLM-judge, cascade, and repeat evaluation modes; model variants encode backend and model-specific prompt/runtime settings.
- `opencompass/configs/datasets/demo/demo_gsm8k_chat_gen.py`
- `opencompass/configs/models/qwen2_5/vllm_qwen2_5_7b_instruct.py`
- `opencompass/configs/summarizers/default.py`

## Dataset and prompt boundary
Dataset adapters load/normalize benchmark records and benchmark-specific evaluation logic. The OpenICL layer turns records into prompts using standard/raw templates and optional few-shot retrieval. This separates benchmark semantics from model execution and supports objective, long-context, code, agent, and subjective datasets.
- `opencompass/datasets/base.py`
- `opencompass/datasets/huggingface.py`
- `opencompass/openicl/icl_dataset_reader.py`
- `opencompass/openicl/icl_prompt_template.py`

## Inference abstraction
Inferencers execute prompt batches in distinct modes: generation/chat, likelihood/perplexity, agent, attack, self-consistency, and parallel variants. Model wrappers isolate local-model and remote-API protocols from the evaluation pipeline. Local paths support HuggingFace, vLLM, LMDeploy/TurboMind; API adapters cover OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, Qwen, and other providers.
- `opencompass/openicl/icl_inferencer/icl_gen_inferencer.py`
- `opencompass/openicl/icl_inferencer/icl_chat_inferencer_parallel.py`
- `opencompass/models/huggingface.py`
- `opencompass/models/openai_api.py`
- `opencompass/models/vllm.py`

## Evaluation and judge pipelines
Predictions flow to task-specific evaluators for exact-match, HF metrics, code execution, likelihood, and specialized benchmark scoring. LLM-as-judge and cascade evaluators are a distinct boundary: they can invoke one or more evaluator models sequentially rather than directly compare outputs with references.
- `opencompass/openicl/icl_evaluator/icl_base_evaluator.py`
- `opencompass/openicl/icl_evaluator/code_evaluator.py`
- `opencompass/evaluator/generic_llm_evaluator.py`
- `opencompass/evaluator/cascade_evaluator.py`

## Task orchestration and execution infrastructure
Tasks package inference/evaluation work; partitioners split datasets or workers; runners execute locally or submit to cluster/cloud schedulers. This enables GPU model parallelism and data-parallel/distributed evaluation without coupling benchmark definitions to deployment.
- `opencompass/tasks/openicl_eval.py`
- `opencompass/tasks/openicl_infer_concurrent.py`
- `opencompass/partitioners/num_worker.py`
- `opencompass/runners/local.py`
- `opencompass/runners/slurm.py`
- `opencompass/runners/dlc.py`

## Results, aggregation, and external dependencies
Run outputs are persisted and summarized into per-dataset, grouped, multi-model, and subjective reports. Dataset material may be prepared locally, downloaded from OpenCompass storage, or loaded through ModelScope. API-model evaluation requires provider credentials; accelerated local inference requires optional LMDeploy or vLLM environments.
- `opencompass/summarizers/default.py`
- `opencompass/summarizers/multi_model.py`
- `opencompass/metrics/dump_results.py`
- `opencompass/utils/result_station.py`
- `requirements/lmdeploy.txt`
- `requirements/vllm.txt`
